# Eren Kumcuoglu

> C-Level Executive · Istanbul, Turkey — 19 years scaling fintech, crypto, gaming, and consumer tech businesses across Turkey and Europe.

## About

Eren Kumcuoglu is a seasoned C-level executive based in Istanbul, Turkey, specializing in scaling fast-growth companies in regulated industries. He currently operates as an independent executive. His career spans fintech, cryptocurrency, gaming, micromobility, and marketing communications — with full ownership from P&L to people.

Core competencies:
- Executive Leadership & Corporate Governance
- Business Strategy & P&L Ownership
- Operational Excellence & Process Design
- Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management (Visa, Mastercard, TCMB, MASAK)
- Payments & Treasury Infrastructure
- Sales, Partnerships & Commercial Growth
- Product, Data & Platform Strategy
- People, Culture & Organisational Design

## Notable Achievements

- **₺25B+ Monthly TPV at Ozan** — Rebuilt cross-functional operations, drove Ozan to top-5 issuer and top 2 acquirer in Turkey.
- **€15M fan token in 19 minutes** — Brazil National Team fan token sold out at Bitci (fastest on record at the time).
- **Spain token €12.5M in 4 hours** — Proved the repeatable go-to-market playbook.
- **Zula Mobile #1 Day 1** — App Store chart-topper across all platforms within 24 hours of launch.
- **Huawei 2.8%→32% in 18 months** — Gold Effie Award-winning brand strategy.
- **Ininal KYC users ×2, merchant revenue ×4** — Simultaneous growth and cost reduction in regulated fintech.
